_comment: PERMANENT exemptions. Every entry states WHY, and the reason must survive a hostile
read — 'it is hard to change' is not a reason. This file is not where debt goes;
that is .vocabulary-baseline.json, which may only shrink.
The bar: a term is exempt only when the user is BETTER OFF seeing it. Search
synonyms qualify because a user who knows the jargon must still be able to find the
control that hides it — removing them would punish exactly the people the old copy
